query:
SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brouillon_ligne
                           WHERE cabinet_id = $1 AND dossier_id = $2 AND tiers_id = $3)
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecriture_validee_ligne
                           WHERE cabinet_id = $1 AND dossier_id = $2 AND tiers_id = $3))
           AS "mouvemente!"
